title: Historical automated-backlog depth remediation: measurement companion

scope.included: Automated atom-derived problem mining, research, optioning, planning, shadow qualification, export readiness, and outcome tracking.
scope.excluded: IDEA and other externally originated work as sources of new automated cases.
scope.primary_objective: Mine real unactioned problems, establish their causal mechanisms, plan solutions that close those mechanisms, and prove the original problems were resolved.

interpretation.single_blended_score_reason: Mining coverage, offline contract tests, live model validity, shadow qualification, and real outcome resolution are different evidence layers. Combining them would conceal the current live failures.
interpretation.unknown_policy: Unknown and not-measured values are not converted to zero percent.

offline_benchmarks.label: Aggregate multi-hop causal coverage benchmark
offline_benchmarks.failure: The fixture accepts two disjoint supports whose symbol union covers core.enter and core.resolve, but neither support proves a connecting call path. The symptom-bearing harness can also be treated as an entrypoint. A green assertion therefore certifies disconnected evidence as one causal mechanism.
offline_benchmarks.consequence: The aggregate mechanism feature and its nominal green test must be treated as failed until a connectivity invariant and a production-entrypoint binding are added and reviewed.

cycles.interpretation: The cycle explicitly dispositioned the 133 eligible source atoms, but every assigned mining job failed and every atom remained unresolved. It generated no usable backlog work.

cycles.placeholder_caveat: The 15 retained research items and 15 backlog entries are blocked failure placeholders. They are not accepted research proofs, solution options, plans, implementation-ready tickets, or evidence of resolution.
cycles.trend_note: Mining and raw-report throughput improved: two miners verified, 85 source atoms supported 15 cases, and 14 raw reports were substantive. Accepted research did not improve: zero of 15 passed the evidence gate, zero plans were produced, and the cycle still failed.

live_shadows.research_origin_pending_caveat: Both shadow states report 311 high-severity atoms pending disposition. Those atoms originated from research output and are distinct from the 133 eligible source atoms evaluated by problem mining; the counts must not be combined into a single source-evidence denominator.
live_shadows.current_code_caveat: The two shadows ran once each on different earlier remediation commits. Neither measures the current uncommitted fixes, neither contributes to one consecutive streak across one exact revision, and neither qualifies the system for export.

classifications.label: readable but origin unproven and protected

active_generated_queue.note: Ready is the old workflow state, not evidence that these tickets are causally valid. Reconciliation is intentionally deferred until qualification.

new_contract_resolution_rate.reason: No backlog has yet been regenerated and implemented under a qualified revised pipeline; the qualified-case denominator is zero.

historical_resolution_rate.reason: Historical outcome provenance and artifact integrity are insufficient to establish either numerator or denominator.

what_is_proven: The encoded historical, positive-depth, full-chain, and outcome contracts pass their currently collected offline tests.
The execution plan records that the last committed revision completed all 14 project test environments without a shortened timeout; raw matrix logs are not linked in this companion.
Both controlled Stage 3 attempts used the direct signed-in host ChatGPT subscription path without API fallback.
The pipeline blocked invalid Stage 3 dossiers instead of advancing them.
what_is_not_proven: That current uncommitted research changes produce a valid live causal dossier.
That aggregate multi-hop evidence forms one connected causal mechanism; the current nominal test is a known false positive.
That two consecutive real shadow cycles can produce well-researched, code-grounded ready plans.
That a regenerated backlog can be implemented and its original problems resolved.
Any aggregate historical or new-contract solve rate.
next_decisive_measurements: Correct and adversarially test the aggregate support-connectivity and production-entrypoint invariants.
Run the full project matrix and exact-revision live subscription-backed Stage 3 again.
Run two consecutive export-disabled shadows and inspect their cases, evidence, plans, and stability.
Only then reconcile tickets, regenerate, implement, replay original scenarios, and record outcomes.

limitations: Percentages are descriptive ratios for their stated denominators, not estimates of future success probability.
The two Stage 3 attempts are retries for one case; they are not two independent cases.

The two shadows ran on different earlier commits and contain model-dependent outputs. Their overall pass states are comparable; every internal count is not necessarily a like-for-like quality measure.
Offline test counts can grow as benchmarks are added. A stable 100 percent pass ratio does not mean the objective is 100 percent complete.
The aggregate multi-hop benchmark is deliberately reported as semantic failure even though its current assertion passes.
Historical resolution is unknown, not zero. New-contract resolution is not measurable because no qualified cases have completed the lifecycle.
Current uncommitted changes have not yet been rerun through live Stage 3, live shadows, or the full end-to-end ticket lifecycle.
